```{r setup, message = F,echo=F,warning=F}
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
details <- data.frame(params$user_table)
billing_name <- details$Full.name
billing_address <- details$Address 
contact_no<-details$Phone
inv_no <- sub("^pay_", "", details$payID)
bill_date<-as.Date(params$bill_date)
plan<-details$Select.Your.Plan
payment_method<-details$payMethod
# Initialize variables
selected_plan <- NULL
amount <- NULL
amount_in_wrd <- NULL

# Check the plan and assign values accordingly
if (grepl("94400", plan)) {
  selected_plan <- "Subscription Plan Half Year"
  amount <- 800.00
  discount <- 0.00
  gst <- 144.00
  total<-amount-discount+gst
  amount_in_wrd <- "\\textbf{Rupees Nine Hundred and Fourty Four only}"
}
if (grepl("23600", plan)) {
  selected_plan <- "Subscription Monthly plan"
  amount <- 200.00
  discount <- 0.00
  gst <- 36.00
  total<-amount-discount+gst
  amount_in_wrd <- "\\textbf{Rupees Two hundred and thirty six only}"
}
```   

```{r table, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results='asis'}
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)

# Assuming params$user_table is a data frame passed from R Markdown parameters
details <- data.frame(params$user_table)
plan <- details$Select.Your.Plan

# Create a data frame for the table
invoice_data <- data.frame(
  Description = c("RM One Way ANOVA module (RAISINS)", "", "", "", "", "", "", "Amount in Words"),
  Plan = c(selected_plan, "", "", "Discount", "GST(18%)", "Total", "", amount_in_wrd),
  Amount = c(paste0("Rs. ", amount,"/- "), "", "", paste0("Rs. ", discount,"/- "), paste0("Rs. ", gst,"/- "), paste0("\\textbf{Rs. ", total, "/- }"),  "",""),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# To handle the percentage symbol in LaTeX, replace it with \% in the Plan and Amount fields
invoice_data$Plan <- gsub("%", "\\\\%", invoice_data$Plan)

# Print the table with LaTeX formatting
table_latex <- kable(invoice_data, format = "latex", escape = FALSE,booktabs = T) %>%
  row_spec(0,bold=TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling("bordered",latex_options = "hold_position", full_width = FALSE)

table_latex
```
